citations.title: A new type of user requires a new type of architecture
excerpts: Published Oct '26
The result is Centaur - our Postgres compatible, horizontally scalable SQL query engine.

Finally, we have introduced Attio Data Connectors. This innovative new product offering exposes a hosted, global, PostgreSQL wire protocol compatible SQL endpoint at `data.attio.com` . Customers are now able to provision unique credentials for their workspace which allow them to connect agents and tools that already support PostgreSQL directly to Attio.

Alongside this exciting new form factor for data in Attio, we are also introducing a powerful upgrade to our data model in the form of Interfaces. Interfaces bring the familiar software engineering concept to Attio, allowing users to express a shared set of attributes and configuration between multiple different Objects in our data model.
